items.description: Paint Kingdom is a painting contractor founded almost a decade ago that has built a reputation for high-quality finishes across Pretoria and the wider Gauteng region. The company set out to elevate painting standards for residential, commercial and new development projects, and says it remains committed to consistent results on every job. Its stated core values are quality and craftsmanship, meaning superior finishes with meticulous attention to detail; customer satisfaction, through prioritising client needs; and professionalism and integrity, with honest and transparent dealings. Palladium Hair Company is part of a hair and beauty brand founded in 1997, with salons in Pretoria and Cape Town. Its services are organised for three client groups. Palladium Women covers cuts, colour, hair transformations, maintenance and extensions, and a professional range of hair-care products is sold in salon. Palladium Men offers classic and trend-driven looks from barbers and colour stylists who shape each cut to the client's head. It markets and distributes automotive parts and components for do-it-yourself, do-it-for-me and leisure travel customers, and distributes all leading original equipment brands as genuine replacement parts. The group owns well-known aftermarket brands including Midas, Alert Engine Parts, Beekman, Rhinoman, Motolek, Auto Care and Diagnostics, ADCO diesel fuel injection specialists, Clutch and Brake Specialists, and Ferobrake. Its sustainability initiatives aim to reduce the environmental impact of its activities, alongside socio-economic development programmes across South Africa. Motus Aftermarket Parts is a division of Motus Corporation, a diversified, non-manufacturing automotive business with a presence in South Africa and selected international markets.
